title: #366 – Shannon Curry: Johnny Depp & Amber Heard Trial, Marriage, Dating & Love
summary: Dr. Shannon Curry is a clinical and forensic psychologist who conducts research, therapy, and clinical evaluation pertaining to trauma, violence, and relationships. She testified in the Johnny Depp and Amber Heard trial.
